title: Run agent (prompt)
text: The Blazor component trims the prompt and locks duplicate submissions before starting the request.
explanation: Neither client receives the API key. Busy state disables controls while a periodic timer measures elapsed time.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
text: A shared typed C# client posts JSON and requests response headers without buffering the SSE body.
explanation: The client runs natively in MAUI and on the Blazor server in the browser companion. Aspire supplies the API address through service discovery; neither client has the API key.

title: Validate; tools disabled
text: Validate the browser origin and JSON content type before reading the bounded body.
explanation: Host includes the browser port. Foreign origins are rejected without trusting forwarded headers. Prompt validation and tools configuration are shown in the server and SDK excerpts.

title: CreateStreaming(parameters)
text: Build a typed C# request with a model, output limit, one user message and no tools.
explanation: This is the official Messages API client. It does not launch a CLI or automatically provide the separate Agent SDK loop.

title: Prompt; no tools
text: The C# SDK owns the HTTPS request to Claude and exposes its response as IAsyncEnumerable.
explanation: This iterator is the provider boundary in the diagram. The application does not hand-write a second model HTTP client.

title: Model response
text: Inspect typed SDK stream data and accumulate only text deltas and usage fields.
explanation: The excerpt reads the SDK union through its JSON converter. Raw SDK objects, IDs and thinking blocks are never forwarded.

title: Safe text delta
text: Project a text delta into the public application event contract.
explanation: TextDelta is an application label, not an Agent SDK event class. The full answer is accumulated independently for the final result.

title: SSE message event
text: Encode named UTF-8 SSE frames and flush the response to the browser.
explanation: A blank line ends each event. Disabling buffering helps intermediate messages arrive promptly. The shared C# parser handles split bytes, Unicode and CRLF.

title: Update typed state
text: Each typed event updates the shared Razor component state.
explanation: InvokeAsync keeps rendering on the correct context in the native WebView or browser circuit. The visible timeline is bounded without losing the final result.

title: ResultMessage fields
text: Only a completed Claude stream becomes a normalized final result.
explanation: The one model turn, duration, token counts and stop reason come from this run. Non-final stops such as max_tokens are marked as errors. The Messages API does not report a USD cost.

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: Forward each safe event and remember whether a final result was observed.
explanation: A single outstanding MoveNextAsync also lets the API send heartbeat comments while inference pauses. Cancellation closes the iterator; missing final result is a failure.

title: Render answer + metrics
text: Render Markdown with raw HTML disabled, sanitize it and highlight escaped code blocks.
explanation: The Blazor answer panel uses only this sanitized markup. Code tokens are HTML-encoded before colored spans are inserted. Result fields also populate the metric tiles.

title: SSE done event
text: The C# SSE client requires both a final result and the terminal done event.
explanation: UTF-8 StreamReader and line framing handle split codepoints, CRLF and comments. Disposing the response closes transport. Completion never overrides a failed SDK result.

title: SSE error; no done
text: After streaming starts, failures become an SSE error event without done.
explanation: Raw provider exceptions are kept out of the browser. Request disconnects cancel the SDK, and the linked token also enforces a three-minute deadline.

title: Error + snackbar
text: The component restores controls and shows a readable error state with a notification.
explanation: The typed client propagates safe server detail for HTTP failures, with a status-code fallback. Clipboard failures also have a user-visible fallback.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: Reject a missing key before any SDK iteration; invalid input is rejected before the SSE response begins.
code:
if (!settings.Configured) { await Send("error", new { detail = Contracts.MissingKey }); return; }
var finalReceived = false;
explanation: Missing-key stream errors explain the root .env setup. Simple mode returns HTTP 503. Prompt validation produces 422 and neither path spends model credits.
